airspace.title: Airspace monitor
airspace.lead: Detects and tracks drones with a camera and mmWave radar, and follows them with the pan-tilt mount for recording. Observation and alerting only.
airspace.offlineHint: No snapshots are arriving from the observer. To try it without hardware, run this in the vision_cam folder:

scope.title: Radar plan view
scope.aria: Target positions seen from above the mount
scope.legend: Up is straight ahead. Rings are 50 m of ground range, outer ticks are camera targets with unknown range, and the blue line and wedge are the camera heading and field of view.
